name: Digital & OPSEC Footprint Minimization
description: Every device an operator carries creates a digital signature — phone location data, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi probe requests, IMSI exposure to cell towers, and biometric identifiers in access logs. Minimizing this footprint requires leaving personal devices behind, using burner hardware, disabling unnecessary wireless interfaces, and planning movement that does not create a traceable digital record. OPSEC discipline before, during, and after an engagement is what separates a clean exit from a post-incident attribution finding.

tools.name: Bluetooth and Wi-Fi disabled when not in use

blue.det: Difficult to detect directly; combined with other techniques, digital footprint minimization makes post-incident attribution harder.
blue.cm: Cellular IMSI catchers can detect unusual device behavior; Bluetooth scanning logs at entry points; require visitor device registration; deploy wireless monitoring throughout facility.
